How does SCRIPE Relay vNext unify contrast, dark depth, and floating overlay motion?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE-Frontend unifies its entire product shell and auth vault under canonical --scripe-* Relay tokens, curing dark black-crush, broken disabled-CTA contrast, and viewport-sliding floating overlays.12

  1. Defining --scripe-bg: #0b0d10 and --scripe-surface: #15181c separates dark tiers cleanly while keeping primary Signal Lime #C6FF00 paired exclusively with dark ink #0B0D10 (16.40:1).1
  2. Guarding disabled buttons with :not(:disabled):not([aria-disabled="true"]) in globals.css lifts Dark disabled CTA label contrast from 1.09:1 to 8.20:1.1
  3. Replaced global wildcard \* transition overrides with --nx-t-* CSS variables and locked [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] to stop coordinate drift at Frame 0.34
  4. Prefixing transition-none before duration-nx-micro on Radix primitives prevents transition-property: all from interpolating transform-origin across the viewport.56

How do canonical tokens feed Nexus and Auth Vault surfaces?

Diagram structure
  • Canonical Relay Tokens scripe
  • Nexus Shell Tokens nexus
  • Auth Vault Tokens vault
  • Radix Popper Primitives popper
  • Popper Wrapper Lock wrapper
  • Playwright & Vitest Gate telemetry
  • scripe → nexus · Re-base shell palette
  • scripe → vault · Re-base auth stage
  • nexus → popper · Supply colors & duration
  • wrapper → popper · Pin Frame-0 coords
  • popper → telemetry · Assert 0px drift & AA
  1. Canonical Relay Tokens ↗

    Defines neutral dark obsidian (#0B0D10, #15181C), mineral light paper (#F7F8F5, #FFFFFF), Signal Lime (#C6FF00), and semantic status hues in src/app/globals.css.

  2. Nexus Shell Tokens ↗

    Consumed across ~580 shell and module files with distinct hover tints, accessible focus rings (shadow-nx-focus), and dynamic motion duration tokens (--nx-t-micro/standard/panel).

  3. Auth Vault Tokens ↗

    Powers standalone login, signup, and recovery screens with restrained .scripe-auth-stage depth and V3 Relay Grid branding without ambient orbs.

  4. Popper Wrapper Lock ↗

    Freezes [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] and .recharts-tooltip-wrapper via transition: none !important so Floating UI coordinates never animate.

  5. Radix Popper Primitives ↗

    Applies transition-none before duration-nx-micro, symmetric zoom-in-95/fade-in-0 scales from transform-origin tokens, and direct dir RTL propagation.

  6. Playwright & Vitest Gate ↗

    Validates Frame-0 coordinate stability (coordDriftPx: 0), 92/92 WCAG CSS color pairs, disabled CTA ratios, and unit assertions cleanly.

Why did dropdowns and tooltips slide, and how does Frame-0 snap work?

Diagram structure
  • Trigger Control user
  • Radix Popper Wrapper popper
  • Overlay Content Node panel
  • Globals Motion Tokens css
  • user → popper · Click trigger or hover rail icon
  • css → popper · Wildcard rule forces transition-duration: 0.3s
  • popper → panel · Slides transform: translate3d and eases transform-origin
  • css → popper · transition: none !important on popper wrapper
  • user → popper · Trigger open -> Floating UI commits final (x, y) on Frame 0
  • panel → css · Read --nx-t-micro (.14s / .22s / 0s) with transition-none
  • popper → user · Scale 0.95 -> 1.00 directly from trigger origin

Why transition-none before duration-nx-micro is essential

Tailwind animation utilities only behave predictably when transition-property stays none on Radix Content containers. Without explicit transition-none, CSS transition-property: all interpolates transform-origin from the default center (50% 50%) toward --radix-*-content-transform-origin over 140ms, making stationary menus appear to drift from afar.36
